review: Every printed defect, investigation and side-effect result has an independent requirement. Several outcomes require concrete authored targets, phenomena, damage types, recovery or destination contracts. Those contracts and executable effects are not implemented.

entries.acceptance: Each use or hour of continuous use rolls three dice; six or less attracts an authored unwanted visitor or attention. Record the trigger and actual encounter consequence.
Increase the device to an authored oversized category: portable becomes vehicle-carried, vehicle-carried requires a much larger vehicle or building. Validate transport and installation capacity.
Each use or continuous-use hour consumes resources worth two hundred fifty; reject activation without the required resources.
Generate one die plus one persistent side effects using the separate side-effect procedure.
Awkward carried equipment imposes -2 dexterity; a vehicle or vehicle installation instead imposes -2 control checks. Apply only while the burden or installation is relevant.
Generate max(1,one die minus two) persistent side effects.
A powered device needs an explicitly larger supply category; an already vehicle-scale demand becomes grid-scale with authored outages. An unpowered device uses result ten instead.
A nonweapon doubles size, weight and power requirements; a weapon instead halves damage, range and accuracy. Resolve fractional statistics through their applicable arithmetic rules.
After use, require ten minutes cooling. Reuse while hot burns out the device and deals one die burning damage to the user.
Each use or continuous-use hour consumes resources worth twenty-five.
Operation rolls totaling fourteen or more fail regardless of effective skill.
Each use leaves the device requiring minor repairs before it functions again.
Each use requires the user to pass dexterity or be knocked down, even when the device is not a weapon.
Operation rolls totaling ten or more fail regardless of effective skill.
A weapon needs five seconds of preparation; other devices need two hours of careful preparation before each use. Track completion and consumption of preparation.
An operation critical failure permanently destroys the device, preventing repair and salvage. The user avoids two dice injury only with dexterity at -2.

For a result at most zero, deal three dice damage to the experimenter and destroy the device. If it is indestructible, the printed alternative destroys everything within ten yards; require an explicitly authored scene consequence and scope before execution.
Apply the device's primary effect to the experimenter if possible; otherwise deal three dice damage to that person.
Apply the primary effect to an authored nearby target if possible; otherwise deal three dice damage to a nearby person.
Deal two dice damage to the experimenter, with the damage type and defenses defined by the device contract.
Deal two dice damage to an authored nearby person, using the device's defined damage treatment.
Deal one die damage to the experimenter under the device contract.
Deal one die damage to an authored nearby person under the device contract.
Record a superficial cosmetic consequence on the experimenter, without inventing ordinary hit-point loss.
Record a superficial cosmetic consequence on an authored nearby person.
Apply an authored embarrassing entanglement or minor side effect to the experimenter, with any duration and release operation explicitly represented.
Give the experimenter a specific false theory about the device; retain the true function privately and expose only the authored mistaken belief.
No effect or functional information is gained; still record the spent minute and attempt history.
Reveal one previously obscure control without disclosing its function.
Reveal the activation/deactivation control, or a weapon safety.
Provide an authored truthful clue about purpose without granting full operating knowledge.
Demonstrate the primary function with its actual scene consequences, and grant that experimenter operation of it at -4.
Grant reliable operation of one specified secondary function without a skill penalty.
Reveal all secondary controls and their general purposes, allowing those functions at -4.
Grant primary-function operation without a skill penalty.
Reveal all functions and grant operation without a skill penalty.
For a result at least twenty, grant all functions as in nineteen plus a specific authored useful unintended application; do not manufacture unrestricted new powers.

Each use checks health+4 for bodily change or intelligence+4 for mental change. Failure adds one negative character point toward an authored disadvantage; preserve accumulated partial points and apply completed traits through character accounting.
Each use deals one die injury directly to the operator, ignoring armor.
Each use deals one injury directly to the operator, ignoring armor.
Transform an authored target within ten yards into an authored valid form for ten seconds; integrate temporary templates and reversible expiry.

Noise causes ten-minute penalties of -2 dexterity, intelligence and self-control within twenty yards; the operator instead suffers -4 for twenty minutes. Deafness prevents it, earplugs do not. Avoid applying both severities to the operator.

For technological devices, use disrupts radio/television within one mile; other electronics within one hundred yards fail on three dice at most seven, and even simple electrical equipment is affected within ten yards. Magical items instead impose -3 spell checks within ten yards for ten seconds. Define technological failure recovery explicitly.
A four-yard fume area checks each exposed subject's health+3 every second; failure causes nausea for five minutes. Persist the area and individual condition expiry.
Operational noise gives +3 to hearing checks to notice the device.
Visible harmless effects make the source obvious to observers and grant +5 vision to notice activity, without creating damage or blinding effects.
Operation creates a four-yard steam/smoke area using the reference obscuring-fog spell effects; resolve its actual visibility rules through magic rather than treating it as descriptive text.
Each use attracts an authored vermin swarm that disperses ten minutes after shutdown; connect swarm movement, damage and lifetime to the creature module.
Using the device renders its operator unconscious for one die minutes.
Use triggers a specific authored supernatural encounter or dimensional arrival, with explicit locations and participants.
Each use deals one injury ignoring armor to everyone within ten yards, including the operator; enumerate affected targets once.
Each use opens an authored random-destination gate for one second; the user must pass dexterity to avoid falling through. Destination generation and transit are campaign-owned contracts.

Generate a fresh side effect on each use; another eighteen requires two results and repeated recursion increases the required effects. Preserve random consumption and define an explicit bounded-execution policy without silently dropping outcomes.
